What Is Next.js?

Understanding the full-stack React framework and its core capabilities.

Next.js App Router

The React Framework for the WebReact Framework សម្រាប់ Full-Stack Web

Next.js is an open-source React framework created by Vercel. While React is a library for building user interfaces, Next.js provides the full architecture needed for production: routing, rendering, backend actions, and optimization.Next.js គឺជា React framework បង្កើតឡើងដោយក្រុមហ៊ុន Vercel។ ខណៈពេលដែល React គឺជា UI Library, Next.js ផ្ដល់នូវរចនាសម្ព័ន្ធពេញលេញសម្រាប់ Production ដូចជា Routing, Rendering, Backend និង Optimization។

Official Definition: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. You use React Components to build user interfaces, and Next.js for additional features and optimizations.និយមន័យផ្លូវការ៖ Next.js គឺជា React framework សម្រាប់បង្កើត full-stack web applications។ អ្នកប្រើ React ដើម្បីបង្កើត UI និងប្រើ Next.js សម្រាប់មុខងារ full-stack និងការបង្កើនល្បឿន។
Next.js Built-in Capabilities
  • File-System Routing: Folder-based pages, layouts, and nested routes
  • Server Components: Fast rendering with zero client-side JS bundle overhead
  • Server Actions: Type-safe asynchronous mutations directly from forms
  • Asset Optimization: Automatic WebP images, self-hosted fonts, scripts
  • Metadata & SEO: Dynamic Open Graph and search engine tags built-in

Before Learning Next.js

Prerequisites and recommended background knowledge.

Next.js App Router

Essential Prerequisites

Before learning Next.js, you should have a solid grasp of web fundamentals. Next.js builds on top of React, so attempting Next.js without React basics will lead to confusion about what comes from React vs what comes from Next.js.មុននឹងរៀន Next.js អ្នកគប្បីយល់ច្បាស់ពីមូលដ្ឋានគ្រឹះ Web។ ដោយសារ Next.js បង្កើតលើ React បើគ្មានមូលដ្ឋាន React ទេ អ្នកនឹងច្រឡំរវាងអ្វីជារបស់ React និងអ្វីជារបស់ Next.js។

Good News: You do NOT need advanced React state machines or external router knowledge. Next.js simplifies routing and data fetching compared to old client SPAs!ដំណឹងល្អ៖ អ្នកមិនចាំបាច់ចេះបណ្ណាល័យ Router ស្មុគស្មាញនោះទេ! Next.js ជួយសម្រួល Routing និង Data Fetching ឱ្យកាន់តែងាយស្រួល។
Prerequisite Checklist
1. HTML5 & Semantic Elements Required
2. Modern CSS & Tailwind CSS Required
3. JavaScript ES6+ (Async, Arrow, Destructuring) Required
4. React Core Basics (JSX, Components, Props) Required

React Fundamentals You Need

The essential React building blocks required for Next.js App Router.

Next.js App Router
01 • COMPONENTS & JSX

Reusable UI Functions

Components are JavaScript functions returning JSX markup describing what the interface should look like.Components គឺជា functions ដែល return JSX ដើម្បីកំណត់ទម្រង់ UI។

02 • PROPS & CHILDREN

Data Transfer

Passing data from parent to child components via attributes and the special children prop.ការបញ្ជូនទិន្នន័យពី Parent ទៅកាន់ Child តាមរយៈ props និង children។

03 • STATE & HOOKS

Interactive Memory

Using useState and useEffect for client-side state and life-cycle events.ការប្រើប្រាស់ useState និង useEffect សម្រាប់រក្សាទុក state និងគ្រប់គ្រង lifecycle។

04 • EVENT LISTENERS

Handling Clicks & Inputs

Listening to user events via onClick, onChange, and onSubmit handlers.ការចាប់ព្រឹត្តិការណ៍របស់អ្នកប្រើប្រាស់ដូចជា onClick, onChange និង onSubmit។

05 • ASYNC / PROMISES

Asynchronous Data

Handling asynchronous JavaScript promises using modern async and await syntax.ការប្រើប្រាស់ async/await ដើម្បីរង់ចាំទិន្នន័យពី Network ឬ Database។

06 • SERVER VS CLIENT

Execution Boundaries

Understanding that code can run either on the server environment or in the browser window.ការបែងចែកថាតើកូដមួយណាត្រូវដំណើរការលើ Server ឬលើ Browser Client។

Next.js Project Structure

Understanding the App Router layout, folders, and configuration files.

my-app/ Directory Tree

├── app/                  # App Router routes & pages
│   ├── favicon.ico
│   ├── globals.css       # Global CSS & Tailwind
│   ├── layout.tsx        # Root layout wrapper
│   └── page.tsx          # Root page (/)
├── public/               # Static assets (images, SVGs)
│   └── next.svg

├── tailwind.config.ts    # Tailwind CSS config
└── tsconfig.json         # TypeScript config

App Router Architecture

In Next.js App Router, routing is entirely determined by folders inside app/. Files named page.tsx become publicly accessible routes, while layout.tsx provides wrapping layouts.ក្នុង Next.js App Router ការកំណត់ Routing ត្រូវបានធ្វើឡើងតាមរយៈ folders ក្នុង app/។ ឯកសារឈ្មោះ page.tsx ក្លាយជា Route សាធារណៈ ហើយ layout.tsx ផ្ដល់នូវ Layout រួម។

Root layout, shared UI, and global HTML shell.

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import "./globals.css";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "My Application",
  description: "Built with Next.js App Router",
};

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-50 antialiased">
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

Root Layout Responsibilities

The Root Layout is required and defines the top-level <html> and <body> tags. It is shared across all pages in the app and never re-renders during navigation, preserving client state.Root Layout គឺចាំបាច់ត្រូវតែមាន ដើម្បីកំណត់ tag <html> និង <body>។ វាត្រូវបានប្រើរួមគ្នានៅគ្រប់ទំព័រ ហើយមិនត្រូវ Re-render ឡើងវិញពេល Navigation ឡើយ។

// Server Component by default in App Router
export default async function ProductsPage() {

  return (
    <div className="p-4">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Products List</h1>

  );
}

export default async function InvoicesPage() {

    // Next.js caching options:
    next: { revalidate: 60 }, // ISR: cache for 60 seconds
  });
  const invoices = await res.json();

  return (
    <div className="p-4">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Invoices ({invoices.length})</h1>
      {/* Render list */}
    </div>
  );

Public vs Protected Routes

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const sessionToken = request.cookies.get("session")?.value;
  const isDashboard = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith("/dashboard");

  // Protect private routes
  if (isDashboard && !sessionToken) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/login", request.url));
  }

  return NextResponse.next();
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/dashboard/:path*"],
};

Security Basics

Core web security principles: validation, authorization, and sanitization.

RULE 01 • UNTRUSTED CLIENT

Never Trust Input

Client-side validation is only for UX. Always validate and sanitize all form fields and parameters on the server using Zod.ការពិនិត្យកូដលើ Browser គឺសម្រាប់តែ UX ប៉ុណ្ណោះ។ ត្រូវ Validate ទិន្នន័យលើ Server ជានិច្ចដោយប្រើ Zod។

RULE 02 • AUTHORIZE EVERY ACTION

Check Permissions

Always verify that the authenticated user owns the resource before executing any SQL update or deletion.ត្រូវពិនិត្យមើលសិទ្ធិរបស់ User មុនពេលអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យកែប្រែ ឬលុបទិន្នន័យក្នុង Database។

RULE 03 • SQL PARAMETERIZATION

Prevent Injections

Never concatenate raw strings into SQL queries. Always use tagged template literals or ORMs to ensure automatic escaping.កុំតភ្ជាប់ String ចូលក្នុង SQL Query ដោយផ្ទាល់។ ត្រូវប្រើ Parameterized Queries ដើម្បីការពារ SQL Injection។

Mistake: Everything Is Client

MISTAKE: Adding "use client" everywhere

Beginners often add "use client" to every file as soon as they encounter any issue. This converts your app back into a heavy client SPA, discarding all performance and SEO benefits of Server Components!អ្នកទើបរៀនតែងតែដាក់ "use client" លើគ្រប់ file។ ការធ្វើបែបនេះធ្វើឱ្យ Next.js ក្លាយជា Client SPA ធម្មតាវិញ និងបាត់បង់អត្ថប្រយោជន៍ល្បឿនទាំងអស់!
